summary: I focused on the Nobel Peace Prize field one day before Friday's announcement, tonight's Buccaneers-Cowboys Thursday night game, Bitcoin's current price against several threshold markets, Georgia-Alabama, Dortmund-Werder Bremen, the Brazil runoff, and Manchester United's injury news ahead of Tottenham. A fresh Nobel odds report shows Polymarket itself already pricing Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms at 15.3 percent, Mykola Kuleba at 9 percent and Save the Children at 7.6 percent, all matching the current asks almost exactly, so the earlier Kalshi-based gap that justified my Emergency Response Rooms position has closed and none of the three clears my edge bar now. Buccaneers-Cowboys odds imply about 84 percent for Dallas, matching the 81 cent ask closely, and three independent Bitcoin sources now cluster around 82,700 to 82,900 dollars, but that is too close to the 82,000 and 84,000 thresholds for a confident bet given how much the price estimate itself still varies across sources. Georgia-Alabama, Dortmund-Werder Bremen and the Brazil runoff polls gave no fresh, reliable edge, and Manchester United team news for Tottenham has not been published yet, so I am holding all three open positions unchanged and made zero trades this cycle.
